findings.title: Async forEach pushes to apiDeletes after it is awaited
findings.body: In handleCancelBooking.ts the recurring-cancel path does `bookingToDelete.user.credentials.filter(...).forEach(async (credential) => { const calendar = await getCalendar(credential); ... apiDeletes.push(deletedEvent); })`. Because forEach does not await async callbacks, the outer flow continues and later does `await Promise.all(prismaPromises.concat(apiDeletes))` before the callbacks have finished awaiting getCalendar and pushing. The result is calendar deleteEvent promises are never awaited and may never be observed, so recurring cancellations can leave orphan events on external calendars and swallow errors.

findings.title: Async forEach makes calendar/video deletes fire-and-forget and uncaught
findings.body: In vital/lib/reschedule.ts `bookingRefsFiltered.forEach(async (bookingRef) => { ... await getCalendar(...) ... })` is not awaited and the surrounding try/catch cannot catch rejections from an async forEach callback. The function then sends reschedule email and returns true without waiting for deleteEvent/deleteMeeting to finish, so failures become unhandled rejections and old calendar/video events may not be deleted before return.

findings.title: Async forEach makes calendar/video deletes fire-and-forget and uncaught
findings.body: In wipemycalother/lib/reschedule.ts `bookingRefsFiltered.forEach(async (bookingRef) => { ... await getCalendar(...) ... })` is not awaited and the surrounding try/catch cannot catch rejections from an async forEach callback. The function then sends reschedule email and returns true without waiting for deleteEvent/deleteMeeting to finish, so failures become unhandled rejections and old calendar/video events may not be deleted before return.

findings.title: Async forEach for reschedule deletes is never awaited
findings.body: In bookings.tsx requestReschedule does `bookingRefsFiltered.forEach(async (bookingRef) => { const calendar = await getCalendar(...); return calendar?.deleteEvent(...) })` with no await, Promise.all, or return of the promises. The mutation therefore finishes, sends reschedule email and webhooks without waiting for external calendar/video deletions, and any rejection inside the callback is unhandled and invisible to the caller.
